image_description: A yellow, suspended traffic light assembly hanging from overhead wires against a blue sky. The unit features multiple signal faces: a central vertical stack of three circular lights (top red, middle amber/yellow, bottom green/blue-tinted) and two side-mounted horizontal signals with arrow indicators (left turn and right turn). The housing is yellow with black visors over each lens. Complex wiring and mounting hardware are visible at the top.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a complex assembly with a central vertical housing containing three circular lenses and side horizontal housings. This matches the structural description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Lenses are clearly visible, large, and have colored covers (red, amber, blue/green).

artifact_observations.location: Top mounting bracket and wire connections
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mechanical assembly at the very top where the wires meet the light housing appears slightly 'mushy' or fused. The individual strands of the cable and the bolts lack crisp definition, blending into each other more than real metal hardware would.

The bottom lens has an unusual blueish tint and the internal pattern looks somewhat irregular compared to the clean circles above it. It may be a reflection artifact or a slight generation error in the lens texture.
The perspective on the side-mounted arrow signals is slightly inconsistent; the left arrow housing seems to protrude at a different angle than the right, creating a minor spatial ambiguity.

Clarity and separation of individual wire strands
Physical plausibility of lens reflections and colors

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the top mounting hardware. AI often struggles with complex mechanical assemblies involving thin cables and bolts. Check if the wires appear to physically attach to the housing or if they just fade into it. Also, verify if the blue tint on the bottom light is a valid filter color or a chromatic aberration artifact.
